title: 100% Zakat eligible: give your Zakat this Ramadan
story: Assalamu alaikum. This campaign is 100% Zakat eligible. Every pound you give is Zakat eligible and will be spent in a Zakat eligible way, and our scholars have confirmed that the campaign is Zakat eligible. Ramadan is the best of times to give and the reward is multiplied. We are raising 25,000 GBP for the work we do in our community, which we have been doing for nine years, alhamdulillah. The need is enormous and it grows every single year. Please give generously, and please share this page with your family and your groups. Do not let this Ramadan pass you by. Your Zakat is an obligation and we make it easy to fulfil. May Allah accept it from you and from us.

label.notes: The campaign asserts its own standing four times and describes what it does once, in six words. An assertion is a claim about the answer rather than evidence for it, so no category can be resolved from this page and every one of the eight is left open, which is the accurate reading of prose that says nothing about who receives, what they receive, or what the work consists of. The escalation is the specific one for this shape: a stated eligibility with no category supported behind it, put to the reviewer with the organizer's own words quoted so they read the claim rather than a summary of it. This case is in the corpus deliberately, because a pipeline that treats the phrase as though it were the fact it asserts would look confident here and would be wrong in the direction the research brief describes as silent and unrecoverable for the donor.
